work.description: Configuration for the ACD (Acceptance-Criteria Development) work stream: the flat, chronological stream of milestone / story / task / uat items.

dir.description: Path, relative to the repo root, to the flat work-item stream (NN_type_slug folders).

agents.description: How ACD role agents are orchestrated.

mode.description: orchestrated = the main session spawns role sub-agents; solo = the main session performs every role inline.

productOwner.description: inline = the main session authors SPEC/story/acceptance; agent = delegate authoring to the aof-product-owner sub-agent.

tags.description: Project-specific tag vocabulary (the closed set the validator enforces). Universal tags (@executable, @manual, @bug, @wip, @milestone-NN, @uat-<id>) are owned by the framework, not configured here.

ui.description: UI / design-review settings. ACD does NOT boot the app — the project runs it; ACD only points at it.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running app the design-conformance review renders surfaces against (e.g. https://localhost:1234); each DESIGN.md surface's Route is appended. Overridable per run with `aof:verify --url`.

a11y.description: OPTIONAL a11y lane config (milestone 07, ADR-004). Records the conformance LEVEL only; the lane opts IN via work.tags.domains containing the bare string "a11y" — NOT "@a11y"; it is deliberately the lone unprefixed domain token, so do not "normalise" it to an @-prefix or the opt-in silently breaks (no schema change to enable). Absent ≡ default/off. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.ui.baseUrl.

level.description: WCAG conformance level; default AA when the lane is on. Enum-only (the work.headroom.mode precedent — no separate type:string).

headroom.description: OPTIONAL headroom plugin config (milestone 06). Absent ≡ off — the work-board terminal launch is byte-for-byte unchanged when this block is absent or { enabled: false }. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.ui.

enabled.description: The master switch. An absent block OR enabled:false leaves the terminal launch unchanged (raw passthrough).

mode.description: wrap ONLY in v0; proxy is rejected at the schema (ADR-002 — a different runtime topology, not yet shipped). An enabled block with no mode defaults to wrap at runtime.

providers.description: OPTIONAL subset of routable providers to front; absent ⇒ both ["claude","codex"]. gemini is never a valid member (ADR-003 — not OpenAI-compatible, never routable).

doctor.description: OPTIONAL work-doctor health-lane config (milestone 15, ADR-003). Tunes the deterministic `work:doctor` cross-item checks. Absent ≡ defaults. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.headroom.

staleWindowDays.description: The freshness window in days: an in-progress item whose `updated` date is older than `now` by more than this is a `stale-updated` finding (milestone 15 story 02). Injected into the engine as a duration so freshness findings are deterministic in CI. Absent ⇒ 30 days.

budgets.description: OPTIONAL per-artifact line budgets for the work-doctor doc-bloat check (milestone 16). Each is the max line count before a `doc-over-budget` warn finding fires for that artifact kind. Absent keys ⇒ documented defaults (spec 300, architecture 700, story 150). Closed (additionalProperties:false).

spec.description: Max lines for a milestone SPEC.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 300.

architecture.description: Max lines for a milestone ARCHITECTURE.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 700 (ADR logs legitimately grow).

story.description: Max lines for a story STORY.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 150.

roadmap.description: OPTIONAL structured milestone-index ROADMAP (milestone 15, ADR-004). When present and machine-parseable, the work-doctor `roadmap-folder-mismatch` cross-reference activates and diffs the indexed milestones against the on-disk folders. Absent ≡ honest no-op (a prose/backlog ROADMAP is NOT a structured index and never triggers the check). Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.doctor.

index.description: The structured milestone index: one entry per milestone the ROADMAP declares.

integrations.description: OPTIONAL external-integration config (milestone 17). Absent ≡ off — every aof work command behaves exactly as before; a present `notion` block opts the project into Notion work-board sync. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.doctor.

notion.description: OPTIONAL Notion work-board sync config (milestone 17, ADR-004). PRESENT ⇒ all binding lives here; ABSENT ⇒ `notion:sync-work` is an honest no-op. The token is NEVER committed here — only `tokenEnv`, the env-var NAME (RESEARCH §A2). Closed (additionalProperties:false), so an unknown field (e.g. a `token`/`databaseId` field) is rejected.

dataSourceId.description: The Notion data_source_id the milestone + its story sub-tasks live in (RESEARCH §A7 — NOT a bare database_id; the 2025-09-03 API routes query/create through the data source).

tokenEnv.description: The NAME of the env var the integration token is read from at run time (RESEARCH §A2). The token itself is NEVER stored in config — this is the env-var reference only.

statusProperty.description: The board's status/select property name the aof status maps onto (the property TYPE is read at run time, §A4).

statusMap.description: MANDATORY map (RESEARCH §A4): each of the four aof statuses → an EXISTING board option NAME. All four entries are required — `in-review` has no Notion default, so the operator MUST supply it. Closed (additionalProperties:false).

not-started.description: The board option name for the aof `not-started` status.

in-progress.description: The board option name for the aof `in-progress` status.

in-review.description: The board option name for the aof `in-review` status (no Notion default — must be supplied).

done.description: The board option name for the aof `done` status.

relationProperty.description: The board's self-relation property name a story sub-task is linked to its milestone page through (RESEARCH §A3).

memory.description: Work-memory backend selection (milestone 05). OPTIONAL — an absent `memory` key is equivalent to { "backend": "none" } (the graceful no-op). `backend` is an enum of the registered backend names.

backend.description: The memory backend that answers the `aof work memory` verbs. `local` = the cheap derived-index backend; `none` = a no-op so ACD runs unchanged when memory is absent; `graphify` = the graph-grounded backend (records from the 05 parsers, re-ranked by a work-stream graph built via invoke('graph:build')).
